title: Ludia

paragraphs: Yuchasin lists Rabbi Shimon bar Ludia. In Shemot Rabbah 3:5 we find Rabbi Shimon Ludia. Perhaps its reading was bar Ludia and Yuchasin likewise meant that he was a native of Lod.

notes.text: The consulted Shemot Rabbah paragraph has Shimon Ludia, confirming the work and 3:5 locator. Hyman’s bar Ludia reading and native-of-Lod explanation remain tentative.

The supplied citation בש״ר פ״ג־ה corresponds to the consulted Shemot Rabbah 3:5 passage, which gives Shimon Ludia. The form Shimon bar Ludia in Yuchasin is Hyman’s report. The proposed connection with Lod is his suggestion.
